illustrations.text: A reading of exactly 30 mg per 100 ml does not exceed 30 mg, so the per se limb is not made out.
A reading of 31 mg exceeds the threshold and completes the offence.
The drug limb has no numeric threshold: incapacity is the test.
Intoxication alone is not an offence; the section requires driving or attempting to drive.
